name: 14 · Gmail finance ingest (every 10 min · pulls bank/billing emails → /data/finance-events/gmail)

filters.q: newer_than:1d (from:(*@chase.com OR *@bofa.com OR *@bankofamerica.com OR *@wellsfargo.com OR *@capitalone.com OR *@usaa.com OR *@citi.com OR *@citibank.com OR *@discover.com OR *@amex.com OR *@americanexpress.com OR *@paypal.com OR *@venmo.com OR *@cashapp.com OR *@zelle.com OR *@quicken.com OR *@quickbooks.com OR *@intuit.com OR *@plaid.com OR *@stripe.com OR *@square.com) OR subject:(statement OR balance OR payment OR transaction OR deposit OR withdrawal OR transfer OR bill OR invoice OR receipt OR autopay OR overdraft OR "low balance" OR "large purchase"))

nodes.name: Gmail · pull finance messages
nodes.notes: REQUIRES n8n Gmail credential: Settings → Credentials → New → Gmail OAuth2 API. Walk through Google Cloud OAuth setup: console.cloud.google.com → enable Gmail API → OAuth client (Web app) → redirect URI from n8n credential page. Then in this node, click the credential dropdown and pick the new Gmail OAuth2.
